_doc: Building exteriors (story 16.7, AD-31). Lengths are base pixels (16 per tile). `overhang`: how far a roof edge hangs over the ground beside the building (side = west and east, top = north); the pieces are images at the object depth of the tile's base line, lent from a fixed pool (`pool`) per chunk of tiles while it is near the view; panes likewise. `awningDepth`: awnings hang over whoever stands under them, so they sit in their own layer above the objects (below the crowns). `windows`: the lit panes. A window is lit when its household is up: from `on` (+ its own spread, minutes) until `off` (+ spread); `occupied` windows only. By day a lit pane is dull (`dayLevel`), it reaches full brightness when the ambient darkness passes `darkness`. Spill: a warm light on the ground below the window, taken from ctx.lights; the tier limits how many (quality.json `windowLights`), nearest to the view centre first.
